objective: Train Fullhouse from scratch by self-play and compare to released checkpoint under the frozen six-player protocol.
training_data: Self-play only. Released weights are evaluation reference, never training initialization or targets.

confirmation.comparison: Replace only the Fullhouse slot with candidate; pair with reference on identical seed blocks.
confirmation.criterion: Predeclared practical non-inferiority: lower 95% confidence bound for candidate minus reference exceeds -2 points. Report selected and final-budget checkpoints separately.

constraints: Preserve original short-stack overlay and FP32 ONNX serving.
Do not claim exact historical training reproduction: checkpoint training manifest was not published.
status: Validating backend and restart before main training
